cv.title: Curriculum Vitae
cv.subtitle: Professional background
cv.description: Computer engineer specialised in solution architecture. 10+ years designing and delivering enterprise digital products.
cv.profile: I am a Solutions Architect focused on designing and delivering high-impact enterprise products and platforms. My specialty combines cloud architecture, GenAI, APIs, mobile and web to connect business strategy with technical execution, accelerating the delivery of robust, secure, scalable and maintainable solutions in production.

experience.description: Solutions Architect at IBM for 10+ years leading enterprise projects for top clients across multiple industries. I design, guide and deliver high-impact solutions combining cloud, mobile, web, GenAI and enterprise integration.

projects.title: AI Architecture
projects.summary: Working as part of the El Corte Inglés architecture team, analysing, designing and implementing AI use cases end-to-end. Definition of an application inventory tool with Airflow, AI agent solutions for internal IT teams, and MCP server integration with Jira, Confluence, BMC Helix and SonarQube.

projects.title: Global GenAI Platform
projects.summary: Working as part of Santander's architecture team to define and design the Global GenAI Platform, which will provide GenAI products and services to all consumers and providers of Banco Santander worldwide. Focus on security, scalability and regulatory compliance.

projects.title: Solutions Architecture
projects.summary: Definition of architectural solutions and application development for the naval industry. Working with microservices and real-time patterns, including Watson Assistant and custom AI models. The landscape includes AWS and Azure cloud services, as well as on-premise clusters with Kubernetes and OpenShift.

projects.title: Tickets Mobile App
projects.summary: Mobile app managing the full ticket lifecycle post-purchase at FC Barcelona. Customers attending any club event use the Android/iOS app to access the stadium, museum, etc. I collaborated on the sales process and defined the solution architecture, supporting the development team.

projects.title: Llocs de Treball
projects.summary: Design and development of digital tools for Catalan public employees with enterprise architecture.

projects.title: Digital Architecture
projects.summary: Definition of solutions for digitalisation and online billing in Spain, Chile and Brazil.

projects.title: Agronet Platform
projects.summary: Cloud platform on IBM Cloud with microfrontends (Vue.js, Nuxt.js), APIs (IBM API Connect), Node.js microservices, DDD, OpenShift, IBM AppID, OAuth2, DevOps pipelines, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Strapi CMS, Watson Machine Learning, The Weather Company API, Google Analytics, Hotjar, HubSpot and Push Notifications for the agri-food sector.

projects.title: BizkaiUp
projects.summary: Native Android/iOS mobile app for citizens of Bizkaia during COVID-19. Includes: WordPress CMS on Kubernetes, IBM Push Notifications, Serverless Cloud Functions, Cloudant Database, two augmented reality experiences, text and voice assistant with IBM Watson, video conferencing integration and secure digital credential for legal procedures.

projects.title: Solutions Architect
projects.summary: Working as a technical solution architect at IAG / Iberia Airlines, close to business analysts and development teams, understanding business requirements, analysing possible solutions and designing architectural and technical solutions.

projects.title: Passenger Plus
projects.summary: New Passenger Plus app for Iberia (IAG) cabin crew. iOS app for iPad 2018 and iPhone XR, designed by IBM iX and implemented with IBM Apple Garage. APIs defined with Swagger, business logic in SpringBoot microservices, integration with IBM Cloud.

projects.title: Internet Banking Mobile App
projects.summary: Android/iOS development of the new Internet Banking app for Bank of Cyprus customers. API definition, iOS and Android team leadership, security requirements implementation. Integration of Vasco SDK for security, OTP generation, root detection and colour QR code scanning. Available on Google Play and App Store.

projects.title: Mobility Assessment
projects.summary: Maturity model assessment, mobility capabilities evaluation, mobility strategy definition, platform and tool recommendations, and 18-month mobile architecture and application development roadmap for Enemalta, Water Services Corporation and Arms, companies belonging to the Government of Malta.

projects.title: Watson Chatbot SDK
projects.summary: Android and iOS SDK to integrate Evobank's mobile application with the IBM Watson Conversation virtual assistant, hosted on IBM Bluemix (now IBM Cloud).

projects.title: Web .NET + iOS App
projects.summary: Web application development with Bootstrap and ASP .NET, and iOS app for iPad in collaboration with the Apple-IBM design team in Chicago and IBM Apple Garage in India. Backend integration with Documentum, MS SharePoint, IBM MobileFirst and MS Azure for materials and equipment inspection management.

projects.title: Fiori S/4HANA Activation
projects.summary: Installation, activation and configuration of several standard Fiori applications for Iberia.

projects.title: SO:FIA Broker App
projects.summary: Software architect and project manager role for the new Android and iOS Online Broker SO:FIA application for Banco Santander.

projects.title: B2B Mobile App Integration
projects.summary: Integration of the Rocanet mobile app for Roca's suppliers and customers with SAP ERP backend via SAP Netweaver Gateway.

projects.title: Mobile Architecture Design
projects.summary: Design of the mobility architecture for Bankinter. Security, obfuscation, vulnerability detection, push and web push notification platform, MDM, MAM, MBaaS, continuous integration, digital marketing, online banking, test automation and agile methodology.

projects.title: SAP Fiori UI5
projects.summary: Development of a web and mobile application using SAP UI5 for promotions management and customer assignment for Calidad Pascual in a SAP Fiori architecture.

projects.title: Workshop Management UI5
projects.summary: Web application for Ferrovial Servicios with SAP UI5 for management of work requests, work orders, and equipment and machinery. SAP ECC backend with SAP Netweaver Gateway, OData protocol.

projects.title: Delivery Notes (CAROL)
projects.summary: Offline and hybrid mobile app with SAP UI5 (HTML5+CSS3+JS) and SAP Kapsel plugins for querying and creating site delivery notes for Ferrovial Construcción. Finalist at SAP Awards Europe, innovation category.

projects.title: InSite Phoenix (INSA–IBM)
projects.summary: Development of the InSite application, Phoenix project. Custom ERP for Ferrovial developed by IBM. Modules covering procurement, sales, finance, planning, budgeting, personnel management, security, document management and administration.
